skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of web architecture and services.
Design, build, and deploy a website using modern programming languages like C#, Java, JavaScript, or PHP.
Apply fundamental principles of object-oriented programming in web development.
Connect websites to database management systems.
Work with basic controls, validation controls, and data controls in web applications.
Implement Model-View-Controller architecture in web applications.
Utilize webservices in web application development.
